```{r}
#For comparing size and shape of condensate foci across conditions:
#Install packages and load:
packages <- c(
  "openxlsx", "ggplot2", "ggpubr", "stringr", "dplyr",
  "tidyr", "viridis", "ggsignif", "rstatix", "scales",
  "tidyverse", "patchwork"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
to_install <- packages[!packages %in% installed]
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install)

invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

#MUST CHANGE!! To user location where files are saved:
#----------------------------------
pathName <- "/Users/pathToFilesPostCellProfilerAnalysis/"
#----------------------------------

main_foci_file <- "SizeIntensityGFP_foci.csv"
nuc_file <- "SizeIntensitynuclear_periphery.csv"
secondary_foci_file <- "SizeIntensityDsRed_foci.csv"

#Load in dataframes:
df_Foci <- read.csv(paste0(pathName, main_foci_file))

#df_Nuclei <- read.csv(paste0(pathName, nuc_file))
df_secondaryFoci = read.csv(paste0(pathName, secondary_foci_file))

#Clean dataframes
#df_Nuclei <- df_Nuclei[, c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber")] 
df_Foci <- df_Foci[, c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber", "Parent_nuclear_periphery", "FileName_DAPI", "AreaShape_Area", "AreaShape_Compactness","Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP",  "Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP", "Intensity_MedianIntensity_GFP")]
df_secondaryFoci <- df_secondaryFoci[, c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber", "Parent_nuclear_periphery", "FileName_DAPI",  "AreaShape_Area", "AreaShape_Compactness", "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_DsRed","Intensity_MeanIntensity_DsRed", "Intensity_MedianIntensity_DsRed")]

#Set the ObjectNumber to be the parent nuclei instead of the foci #
df_Foci$FociNumber = df_Foci$ObjectNumber
df_Foci$ObjectNumber = df_Foci$Parent_nuclear_periphery
df_Foci <- df_Foci[df_Foci$ObjectNumber != 0, ]
df_Foci$Parent_nuclear_periphery <- NULL

#Same as above but for the secondary foci (For instance, K48-Ub)
df_secondaryFoci$FociNumber = df_secondaryFoci$ObjectNumber
df_secondaryFoci$ObjectNumber = df_secondaryFoci$Parent_nuclear_periphery
df_secondaryFoci <- df_secondaryFoci[df_secondaryFoci$ObjectNumber != 0, ]
df_secondaryFoci$Parent_nuclear_periphery <- NULL

#Rename the FileName_DAPI column to just "Names"  
colnames(df_Foci)[3] <- "Names"
colnames(df_secondaryFoci)[3] <- "Names"

#-------------------------------
#MUST CHANGE BELOW DEPENDING ON WHAT NAMING CONVENTIONS WERE USED!!!!
#-------------------------------

#Function to extract relevant information from the "Names" column and replace it with more readable names for the plot legend.

replace_names_2 <- function(x) {
  # x <- gsub(".*(Defining substring of condition).*", "Desired Name", x) # Keep the _ underscore between the condition being tested (e.g., drug, sgRNA) and the readout variable (e.g., GFP, tdTomato)
  x <- gsub(".*(Celastrol_3uM_3h_MLF2GFP_K48).*",        "Celastrol_3 µM_MLF2-GFP_K48-Ubiquitin", x)
  x <- gsub(".*(PZ3_3uM_3h_MLF2GFP_K48).*",              "Pyrithione Zinc_3 µM_MLF2-GFP_K48-Ubiquitin", x)
  x <- gsub(".*(Disulfirum_50uM_3h_MLF2GFP_K48).*",      "Disulfiram_50 µM_MLF2-GFP_K48-Ubiquitin", x)
  x <- gsub(".*(Plumbagin_15uM_3h_MLF2GFP_K48).*",       "Plumbagin_15 µM_MLF2-GFP_K48-Ubiquitin", x)
  x <- gsub(".*(DMSO_3h_MLF2GFP_K48).*",                 "DMSO_DMSO_MLF2-GFP_K48-Ubiquitin", x)
  return(x) 
}
 
#-------------------------------

#Rename both dataframes:
df_Foci$Names      <- replace_names_2(df_Foci$Names)
df_secondaryFoci$Names <- replace_names_2(df_secondaryFoci$Names)

#Remove NA (optional)
df_Foci <- df_Foci[!is.na(df_Foci$Names),  ]
df_secondaryFoci <- df_secondaryFoci[df_secondaryFoci$Names != "NA", ]

#Extract relevant drug info from each name
df_Foci$Drug  <- sub("_.*", "", df_Foci$Names) #May need to change depending on particular naming conventions
df_Foci$Marker <- "GFP"

df_secondaryFoci$Drug  <- sub("_.*", "", df_secondaryFoci$Names) #May need to change depending on particular naming conventions
df_secondaryFoci$Marker <- "DsRed"

#Rename the columns so that they can be combined row-wise without issues:
names(df_Foci) <- sub("_GFP$", "", names(df_Foci))
names(df_secondaryFoci) <- sub("_DsRed$", "", names(df_secondaryFoci))

#Merge the primary and secondary foci dataframes
combined_Df <- rbind(df_Foci, df_secondaryFoci)

#Factor drug names so they align on plot correctly
#MUST CHANGE!!
#----------------------------------
combined_Df$Drug <- combined_Df$Drug %>%
  recode_factor(
    "DMSO" = "DMSO",
    "Pyrithione Zinc" = "Pyrithione Zinc, 3 µM",
    "Celastrol" = "Celastrol, 3 µM",
    "Plumbagin" = "Plumbagin, 15 µM",
    "Disulfiram" = "Disulfiram, 50 µM"
  )

drug_levels <- c("DMSO", "Pyrithione Zinc, 3 µM", "Celastrol, 3 µM",
                 "Plumbagin, 15 µM", "Disulfiram, 50 µM")

#----------------------------------


#Factor the primary and secondary marker names:
#MUST CHANGE!!
combined_Df$Marker <- factor(combined_Df$Marker, levels = c("GFP", "DsRed"))
 
#Define variables of interest
vars     <- c("AreaShape_Area", "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity",
              "Intensity_MeanIntensity", "AreaShape_Compactness")
labels   <- c("Area", "Total Integrated Intensity", "Mean Intensity", "Compactness")



sum_vars <- c("Intensity_IntegratedIntensity")  # summed per nucleus; all others averaged

# NUCLEUS-LEVEL AGGREGATION 
# ImageNumber + ObjectNumber = unique nucleus
nucleus_df <- combined_Df %>%
  group_by(Marker, Drug, ImageNumber, ObjectNumber) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(vars), list(
    mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
    sum  = ~sum(.,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Drug = factor(Drug, levels = drug_levels))

# SHARED AESTHETICS
shared_fill <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("GFP" = "#f36f52", "DsRed" = "#871d5b"),
  labels = c("GFP (MLF2-GFP)", "DsRed")
)

shared_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.line         = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size   = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    plot.margin       = margin(t = 25, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

bottom_x_theme <- theme(
  axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                               vjust = 1, color = "black"),
  axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 25, r = 5, b = 80, l = 5)
)

# panel builder:
make_panel <- function(var, ylabel) {

  # Column name in nucleus_df depends on aggregation type
  is_sum <- var %in% sum_vars #sum_vars is the variable/s that will be summed instead of averging 
  col    <- paste0(var, ifelse(is_sum, "_sum", "_mean"))

  #Bar heights: mean across nuclei (± SEM)
  sum_df <- nucleus_df %>%
    group_by(Drug, Marker) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_val = mean(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sem      = if (is_sum) NA_real_
                 else sd(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )

  sem_safe  <- ifelse(is.na(sum_df$sem), 0, sum_df$sem)
  y_max     <- max(sum_df$mean_val + sem_safe, na.rm = TRUE)
  step      <- y_max * 0.07

  group_max <- sum_df %>%
    mutate(top = mean_val + ifelse(is.na(sem), 0, sem)) %>%
    group_by(Drug) %>%
    summarize(group_top = max(top),
              .groups = "drop")

  # Stats: Wilcoxon at nucleus level, each channel vs its own DMSO
  st <- nucleus_df %>%
    group_by(Marker) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(col, "~ Drug")), ref.group = "DMSO") %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(Drug = group2) %>%
    mutate(Drug = factor(Drug, levels = drug_levels))

  # Merge stars onto summary df
  sum_df <- sum_df %>%
    left_join(st %>% select(Marker, Drug, p.adj.signif), by = c("Marker", "Drug")) %>%
    left_join(group_max, by = "Drug") %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj.signif = ifelse(is.na(p.adj.signif) | p.adj.signif == "ns",
                            "", p.adj.signif),
      star_y = pmin(
        group_top + ifelse(Marker == "GFP", step * 1.2, step * 2.4),
        y_max * 1.28
      )
    )

  #Plot
  p <- ggplot(sum_df, aes(Drug, mean_val, fill = Marker)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4,
             position = position_dodge(0.75))

  if (!is_sum) {
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_val - sem, ymax = mean_val + sem),
      width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6,
      position = position_dodge(0.75)
    )
  }

  p +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = star_y, label = p.adj.signif),
      position = position_dodge(0.75),
      size = 5, vjust = 0, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +  
    labs(y = ylabel, fill = "Channel:") +
    shared_fill + shared_theme
}

# BUILD + EXPORT
panels <- map2(vars, labels, make_panel)

panels[[3]] <- panels[[3]] + bottom_x_theme + coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
panels[[4]] <- panels[[4]] + bottom_x_theme + coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

final_plot <- (panels[[1]] | panels[[2]]) /
              (panels[[3]] | panels[[4]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1.4)) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_plot

ggsave(paste0(pathName, "condensate_analysis.pdf"),
       final_plot, width = 12, height = 10, units = "in")

ggsave(paste0(pathName, "condensate_analysis.tiff"),
       final_plot, width = 12, height = 10, units = "in",
       dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")

library(openxlsx)
wb <- createWorkbook()

for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  var    <- vars[i]
  ylabel <- labels[i]
  is_sum <- var %in% sum_vars
  col    <- paste0(var, ifelse(is_sum, "_sum", "_mean"))

  # Summary: mean across nuclei (matches bar heights)
  sum_df <- nucleus_df %>%
    group_by(Drug, Marker) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_of_nucleus_vals   = mean(.data[[col]],   na.rm = TRUE),
      median_of_nucleus_vals = median(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sem                    = if (is_sum) NA_real_
                               else sd(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      sd                     = sd(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nuclei               = n(),
      .groups                = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(aggregation = ifelse(is_sum, "sum per nucleus", "mean per nucleus"))

  # --- Stats: nucleus-level Wilcoxon (matches stars on plot) ---
  st <- nucleus_df %>%
    group_by(Marker) %>%
    wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(col, "~ Drug")), ref.group = "DMSO") %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    ungroup()

  sheet_name <- substr(ylabel, 1, 15)  # shorter to leave room for suffix within 31 char limit

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(sheet_name, "_summary"))
  writeData(wb, paste0(sheet_name, "_summary"), sum_df)

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(sheet_name, "_stats"))
  writeData(wb, paste0(sheet_name, "_stats"), st)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(pathName, "condensate_analysis_results.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)


```
